description: Reviewed active-route design-system exceptions that are runtime geometry, virtualization, drag transforms, or user/project data. New active-route drift should still fail the design gate.

exceptions.reason: Canvas icon imageRendering must stay pixelated for crisp generated company avatars.
Measured max-height and mask state depend on runtime content height.
Virtualizer total-height spacer is computed at runtime.
Virtualized row translate/size is computed at runtime.
Composer spacer mirrors measured composer height.
Mobile composer dock preserves safe-area offset until shared dock utility is introduced.
Part of the reviewed mobile safe-area composer dock offset.
Label swatch color is user/workspace data.
dnd-kit sortable transform and transition are runtime drag state.
dnd-kit sortable style is applied directly to the draggable node.
Mention chip styles encode project colors and agent icon masks from parsed markdown href data.
Autocomplete menu is positioned from caret coordinates.
Project color swatch uses user/project data.
Resizable pane width is controlled by runtime drag state and persisted preference.
dnd-kit sortable transform and transition are runtime drag state.
Worktree branding colors are generated runtime context.
Plugin launcher stack z-index and bounds are runtime geometry.
Plugin launcher popover anchoring comes from DOMRect runtime geometry.
